assets.claim_scope: Fossil-specimen botanical organ concept limited to documented flower/calyx, leafy fertile branch, fruit axis or ovulate cone; no complete parent plant or newly associated organs implied.

observations.williamsonia: Compact oval ovulate cone with restrained tessellated surface and a continuous short stalk; reads as the bounded reproductive organ prop, without invented petals or parent plant. Surface mosaic is legible at medium/near views; fine cells recede at 80 px.
observations.halkieria: Elongated flattened crawler with recognizable front and rear cap shells, ordered overlapping dorsal armour and short marginal sclerites; body stays connected in side and underside runtime views. Simplified plate count is within scope.
observations.ctenorhabdotus: Short oval barrel with relatively flat poles and repeated separated triple comb-band groups. Attempt-02 preserves band rhythm at medium/near views; fine bands soften at 80 px. No tentacle curtain is implied.
observations.conglomerate-outcrop: One continuous faceted matrix contains differently sized rounded clasts and shows the intended bounded cut face/curved relief. The cut face is a teaching presentation surface, not a seamless terrain boundary; no precise site, age or chemistry is claimed.
